methodology.scope: Keyword-search samples, not a census of TikTok Shop.
methodology.demand: Seven-day counter increments; growth uses the same products at t, t-7 and t-14.
methodology.competition: Distinct observed sellers / sampled listings. HHI uses listing shares, not market sales shares.
limitations: Search ranking and query language create selection bias.
Rounded counts, counter resets, missing products and missing dates are not zero sales.
Low seller diversity can indicate dominance by one seller, not an easy market.
Prices are in local currencies; no cross-currency price ranking is performed.

evaluation.interpretation: Model selected only on validation. Test errors may be worse than the baseline; all results retained.
evaluation.evaluation_policy: Rolling evaluation snapshot, not a repeatedly untouched holdout. No claim of real orders or profit.
